P. B. Mangathayar, vs State Of Telangana, on 7 August, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy

entities.text: P. B. Mangathayar, vs State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioners, seeking the following relief:
"....to issue a Writ, Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS declaring the action of the respondent authorities in not acquiring the complete structure of Padmahamsa residential apartment at D.No.9-1-83, 84/1,
Sardar Patel Road Secunderabad and the complete site and pay compensation as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as illegal, unconstitutional and consequently direct the respondent authorities to acquire complete Block-A of Padmahamsa residential apartment at D.No.9-1-83, 84/1, Sardar Patel Road Secunderabad along with the site, pay compensation as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for the residential apartment based upon the market value and give the rehabilitation package to the petitioners and pass...."
2.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Sri Verender Singh, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners fairly submitted that the cause in this writ petition does not survive for adjudication.
Therefore, no further orders are required and hence seeks to dismiss the same as infructuous.
3. Sri K. Ravinder Reddy, learned Government Pleader for GHMC is present.
4. In view of the same, this writ petition is dismissed as infructuous.
There shall be no order as to costs.

As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
___________________________ C.V. BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 07.08.2024 VSU P. B. Mangathayar, vs State Of Telangana, on 7 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97429813/
